items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch and monetization expansion; keep searchwoot.com private and preview-only. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not commercial/public redistribution, storage, derivatives, prices, images, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; public terms point against the proposed use. All four data-use items remain unresolved. Technical compliance baseline is incomplete at 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain blocked. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Human counsel is required for source rights, jurisdictional privacy, vendor/DPA, notification consent, and any affiliate or advertising expansion. Exact decision: do not launch, monetize, send rights outreach, or change the private gate this cycle.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active with four open tasks and no closures supported by direct evidence. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering repository and deployed data flow, retention/deletion/correction/access behavior, logs and vendors, GA4 settings, consent withdrawal, and stale-data handling; then route rights, jurisdictional privacy, vendor/DPA, and notification-consent gaps to human counsel. Do not enable tracking, change configuration, deploy, expand notifications, or request duplicate telemetry.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked because rights for public display, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, images, prices, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, affiliate, and advertising use are not evidenced. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed pending data inventory, retention, deletion/correction, processor terms, consent, and unsubscribe evidence. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed pending deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional review. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data is evidence_needed pending log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action for each is to capture the missing evidence read-only and route material legal uncertainty to human counsel.

Private or gated-site decision: keep searchwoot.com private and preview-only until the checklist is complete, each data-use item has a Legal disposition, human-counsel issues are resolved, and Security, CTO, CFO, accuracy, measurement, and owner gates are satisfied. No go-live evidence is present, so no go-live proposal is supported.

items.title: cfo-2026-09-30-finance-control-baseline
items.summary: No new finance proposal is needed for legal review; existing evidence already supports preserving the attribution boundary. Do not treat aggregate Amazon commission, clicks, orders, shipped items, sessions, conversions, or AI usage as revenue, margin, ROI, or causal lift.
